## Body

- Squash-merged base (#129 to dc9f2e4) makes the stacked branch (#133) conflict AA on every shared file. Fix: merge the old base branch tip first, check that `git diff <tip> origin/main -- <conflicting files>` is empty, then `git checkout --ours` those files and run `ddocs build` on the merged .dd.json siblings.
- Never stop_bash a running `just shared-build`: cargo is orphaned (ppid 1), keeps compiling and holds the build-dir lock. At load ~40, a niced clippy plus three targeted test binaries took about 75 min, part of it waiting on another lane's lock. To see which cargo is yours, use `lsof -a -p <pid> -d cwd`.
- pm-001's messages often arrive after the push they ask for. Before acting, compare msg_id counters and check `gh pr view N --json headRefOid,baseRefName,body`. Answer with "already in <head>" rather than pushing again.
- Delivers: lines need full addresses for the PRD req, the roadmap step and the blueprint component (#components/c-...). The parser is in crates/core/src/claims.rs (delivers()): commas or spaces, with backticks allowed. Editing a body does not move a frozen head.
- `pij directory memory add --body-file -` is refused through the shim (F30). Write the body to /tmp and pass the path.
